def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Int, BitVec, Function, BitVecSort, BoolSort, Solver, Or, Not, sat

    # Base script constraints
    new_int = Int('new')
    s = Solver()
    s.add(new_int == 0)

    # Constraint set 2 variables
    new = BitVec('new', 64)
    optlen = BitVec('optlen', 64)
    ipv6_optlen = Function('ipv6_optlen', BitVecSort(64), BitVecSort(64))
    IS_ERR = Function('IS_ERR', BitVecSort(64), BoolSort())

    # Constraint 1
    s.add(Or(Not(optlen > 0), Not(ipv6_optlen(new) > optlen)))

    # Constraint 2
    s.add(Or(Not(optlen > 0), Not(IS_ERR(new))))

    return s.check() == sat
